text_chunks: The GenAI Content Transformation Platform uses FastAPI for asynchronous backend service handling and PostgreSQL for persistence.
PyMuPDF is used for PDF parsing, python-docx for Word document structure analysis, and python-pptx for presentation slides.
Sliding window token chunking is implemented with tiktoken cl100k_base encoding with configurable chunk size and overlap.
The retrieval pipeline embeds chunks using OpenAI text-embedding-3-small and performs vector similarity search via FAISS.
